decisions.title: Where server workers get code and push branches
decisions.chosen: Dedicated fleet clone per project (~/fleet-repos/<name>), only remote is the server bare repo
decisions.rationale: Existing server copies pull from GitHub; relinking would break that, and a fleet-only clone cannot push to GitHub by accident
decisions.alternatives: Re-link the user's existing server checkouts to the bare repo

decisions.title: How server workers report to the Mac roster
decisions.chosen: Mac-authoritative roster; per-lane server outbox pulled over outbound ssh
decisions.rationale: Tunnel needs Mac Remote Login and gives the server a key into the Mac; outbox needs no inbound access and survives the Mac sleeping
decisions.alternatives: Reverse ssh tunnel so workers write the Mac roster live

decisions.title: Which remote-worker states to surface
decisions.chosen: unreachable, waiting on a prompt, no report yet, low server disk
